name: Saints Peter and Paul Church

anchor.what: centre of the mapped ground outline at ground level

measurements_m.what: Mapped ground footprint width including rear extension
Mapped wall footprint length excluding projecting entrance pillars
Overall length including projecting entrance pillars
measurements_m.method: Parish gives 160 ft; the model extends from the leading portal pillar to the rear wall (49.207 m). The mapped wall footprint spans 48.08 m.

measurements_m.what: Main nave roof ridge above Filbert Street, survey estimate
measurements_m.method: USGS 2023 central roof returns of approximately 47.4 m minus the central frontage ground datum of approximately 24.55 m. Roof covering rises shallowly above the two aisle roofs.

measurements_m.what: Upper tower shaft cornice above Filbert Street, survey estimate
measurements_m.method: USGS 2023 returns on the upper belfry cornice around both spires measure approximately 64.9 m above the survey datum. Subtract the street datum of 24.55 m.
USGS 2023 roof returns on both side aisles at local y=2 and y=8 m are approximately 45.2 m. Subtract the central frontage street datum.

simplified: Three arched portals, a recessed rose, two open belfries and the tapering pair of spires define the front.
The mapped rear extension is included at a lower height. Ornament, lettering, small statues and glazing use the single body finish.
Four engaged entrance pillars and a raised band stand in for the sculpture and inscription. A projecting rim and two broad mullions suggest rose-window tracery.
Both tower bases meet the map plane, projecting 0.85 m ahead of the main frontage. Broad stepped roof planes group the nave and aisle coverings.
